campaigns.name: Blackglass
campaigns.premise: A harbor-city mystery full of drowned bells, rival smugglers, strange tides, and a conspiracy sleeping beneath the piers.

memberships.character_notes: Seren owes a favor to the Gull and Lantern and keeps a coded map hidden in her boot lining.

announcements.title: Storm Over South Pier
announcements.body: The next session opens at dusk with the harbor under lightning and a quarantine bell ringing from Dock Nine.

announcements.title: Letter from the Harbormaster
announcements.body:
## To the Blackglass Company

If you mean to keep your rooms at the Gull and Lantern, report to the signal tower before midnight.

- Bring any salvage taken from Dock Nine
- Speak to no one wearing a tar-black ribbon
- If the bells ring twice, leave the pier immediately

announcements.title: Private Ledger Scrap
announcements.body: A damp scrap of ledger paper lists three payments under the initials `E.V.` and marks one warehouse with the symbol of a broken bell.

announcements.title: The Bell Beneath Blackglass
announcements.body: Old sailors swear there is a bell chained below the harbor floor. When it rings, doors open in places the city was supposed to forget.

announcements.title: Seal the Smuggler Tunnel
announcements.body:
Find the flooded tunnel under Saltwake Row before the smugglers use it to move the relic crate.

- Speak with the oyster divers
- Follow the tar-black lantern marks
- Decide whether to collapse or claim the route

announcements.title: Find the Lantern Cartographer
announcements.body: Track down the cartographer who maps impossible alleys during red tide nights. Her charts may reveal where the drowned chapel drifts ashore.

notes.title: Mira's Research Notes
notes.body: Shared: the sigil on the quarantine bell matches the one in the drowned chapel sketch from the archives.

notes.title: Ballad Fragments
notes.body: Shared: Elira recognizes the melody from the tavern pianist as part of a funeral song for ships lost beyond the fog line.

notes.title: What The Harbor Knows
notes.body: DM note: every faction in Blackglass is pretending not to hear the second bell.

wiki_pages.title: The Bell Beneath Blackglass
wiki_pages.content:
# The Bell Beneath Blackglass

The bell is said to hang in a stone chamber below the harbor floor. It only rings when the tide rises against the old foundations beneath South Pier.

Rumors claim:
- smugglers use the sound as a signal
- drowned spirits answer the second ring
- the city archives sealed every map leading down to it
